meta.title: feat: add caching layer for frequent identical requests
meta.body_summary: Add a per-project caching layer for identical non-streaming API requests, with configurable cache duration and API endpoints to toggle; aims to reduce latency for frequent identical calls.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added caching layer but no human review; closed after Devin archived, likely due to inactivity and test failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 532 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium change concentrated in new projects API and caching logic. As a performance PR it was closed without merge—no human review or engagement, and the agent was archived.

review_details.concern_detail: No human maintainer provided review or feedback; the only interactions were bot comments. The PR was closed without merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce latency for frequent identical requests via project-level caching with configurable duration.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge; no explicit rejection reason beyond bot indicating Devin was archived.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding caching across multiple packages (db schema, API, gateway) while handling non-streaming requests; agent unable to resolve test database schema mismatch and no maintainer guidance.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after timing evidence; PR body mentions test failures related to DB schema, but no steps to reproduce caching gains.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No fix cycle; maintainer closed PR without addressing test failures.

core_change_summary.description: Added project-level caching layer: added cacheEnabled/cacheDuration columns to project DB schema, created /projects API to toggle caching, implemented cache middleware in gateway chat handler (non-streaming), and introduced an in-memory cache module (lib/cache.ts) with logging integration.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test spec files received minor changes (mock adjustments), and lockfile was updated.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds caching logic, new projects API, cache module, and test adjustments; second commit updates lockfile.
